about: Pay-text miner corpus (job-board .103): real Greenhouse postings from five boards (coinbase, airbnb, databricks, robinhood, figma), read 2026-11-17 with content=true&pay_transparency=true. text = htmlToText(content) as ingest builds it, cut to the windows around every money symbol inside the miner's first 12,000 characters (the builder checked both miners give the same answer on the excerpt as on the whole text). pay = the board's own structured pay_input_ranges [min, max] in whole currency units, or, for the 24 postings with figures and no structured pay, read by hand ([] = no figure is this job's pay). main = extractSalary at 0b9d5dfab on the whole text. Postings whose excerpt and pay are identical are one case; postings counts them.
